data.name: RootDseReadFailed
data.value: Connected to {0} using {1}, but could not read its directory capabilities (RootDSE). This connection cannot be used for capture. {2}

data.name: RootDseMissing
data.value: The controller did not answer a read of its own RootDSE. Without it neither the controls it advertises nor the partitions it serves are known, and a capture pass refuses to run on a connection that cannot say.
